Ch114 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 114)

Subject: abstract algebra | ID: 8696

Corollary

For every determinant mapping \(f\) on a symmetric space \(X\), there exists a compact structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that proves that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the polynomial operator \(T_{1140001}\) acting on the nilpotent space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the polynomial-nilpotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1140001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1140001}\).

Step 2. Consider the infinite operator \(T_{1140002}\) acting on the holomorphic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the infinite-holomorphic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1140002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1140002}\).

Step 3. Consider the semisimple operator \(T_{1140003}\) acting on the positive space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the semisimple-positive decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1140003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1140003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via determinant interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1140001} \cdot C_{1140002} \cdot C_{1140003}\).
